examples.english: Keep watch, and let not thy heart be puffed up, but continue in thy humility, and thou shalt remain in the glory which God giveth to thee.
examples.source: Instructions of Apa Pachomius in MERC.AR in Budge ed. - part 1

examples.english: It shall continue to bear fruit which nourisheth and decayeth not,

examples.english: He who hath fallen hath, in these ensamples, an encouragement not to allow himself to remain | in his fallen state, and he (i.e., the Book) saith, ' Shall not he that is in the habit of falling rise up again?
